title: Five-Note Melodies
body: With just five notes — C D E G A — you can play hundreds of melodies. These are the notes of the C pentatonic scale: no half-steps, no tension, all sound good together.

title: The Five Notes
caption: C D E G A — notice there's no F or B. This gap between E and G (a skip) and between A and the next C gives pentatonic music its open, flowing feel.
